social-33fc7cee078f.text: Here's my sense of the Steve Wilks situation: * Daronte Jones sought extra help on his staff back this summer. * Why Wilks? Obviously experienced as a former HC/4-time DC. Also, he has a background coaching DBs. Same with Jones. I'd expect one of them to focus more on that room. * This has nothing to do with Quinn or Jones' job status or primary responsibilities * As for the apparent change in Wilks' availability, since we were told, he'd be around early in a game week and then go back to his duties at App St. (his alma mater). Now he's expected to be with the team for SNF. Not a weekly expectation at this point, but the situation is fluid. * Why didn't they tell us about the addition in real time (Wilks was around for the 49ers game)? Best guess is they probably would have, if not for the end-of-game gaffe heard 'round the world right as he was joining. The narratives about his addition are all over the place now. Imagine if announced 24 hours after tying the Giants.
